baseline.title: Where are you starting from?
baseline.lead: One hour to see where you stand across the ten courses. It's not a performance review: it shapes your development plan (IDP) and shows the team where to focus.
baseline.lead_back_one: Your timer kept running: about 1 minute left. Your answers are saved.
baseline.lead_back_other: Your timer kept running: about {count} minutes left. Your answers are saved.
baseline.privacy_body: Only you, the Planning Director and HR L&D see your results. Team views show averages of 3 or more people. Managers see none of your scores.
baseline.part_a_hint: Rate where you are today, not where you'd like to be. There are no right answers here. Rate all 10 to go on.
baseline.part_b_hint: Choose one answer each. If you really don't know, leave it — it counts as not yet.
baseline.part_c_hint: Read the case, then answer six questions about it. The case stays in view.
baseline.how_timer: The 60-minute timer starts when you begin and keeps running if you leave; at 60:00 your answers are submitted automatically.
baseline.how_save: Answers save as you go, on this device and in the Hub. If your connection drops, keep going.
baseline.how_feedback: You won't get feedback on individual questions — that keeps the December re-test fair.
baseline.how_alone: Work alone and don't search. An honest "not yet" is more useful than a guess.
baseline.confirm_body: The timer keeps running if you leave the page. At 60:00 your answers are submitted automatically.
baseline.resumed: Welcome back. Your answers are where you left them.

baseline.rate_all_other: Rate all {total} statements to go on — {count} left.

baseline.review_left_other: {count} questions are unanswered. Unanswered questions count as wrong. Once you submit, your answers are locked so the December re-test stays fair.
baseline.review_done: Everything is answered. Once you submit, your answers are locked so the December re-test stays fair.

baseline.confirm_submit_left_other: {count} questions are unanswered and count as wrong. You can't change your answers after this.

capstone.title: Capstone
capstone.bring_pitch: Project charter and mid-point results, 8 slides at most, with action titles.
capstone.bring_capstone: Verified results, the value, and the rule or process that keeps it; 10 slides at most. Then the whole team runs a mock S&OP cycle.
capstone.panel_who: VPSC, Quân, HR L&D and the three managers
capstone.form_intro: Anyone in the team can save; the panel reads the latest version. You can save as often as you like until the deadline.
capstone.soi_intro: Answer first, in three short parts — 60 words each at most.
capstone.kpi_intro: From the system of record, before and after.

h.project_title: A gap in numbers and a date reads best.
h.soi_observation: What changed or what's wrong, ending with the question the project answers.
h.soi_implication: Your answer and what it means: the decision you ask for.
h.evidence_url: An internal SharePoint link (https://…). Don't paste company data into this form — link to it.
h.value_vnd: Digits only. The preview shows how it reads.
h.value_basis: The steps and assumptions behind the number.
h.value_basis_cap: The steps and assumptions behind the number, agreed with Finance.
h.lessons: What you'd keep and what you'd do differently.

panel.intro: Score each team from 1 to 5 on five criteria. Your scores are saved for you as a judge, and you can change them later.
panel.no_teams_body: Teams appear here once Quân or HR L&D set them up.
panel.forbidden_title: This page is for the panel
panel.forbidden_body: Only panel members and admins can score teams.

panel.comment_hint: One thing to keep, one thing to change.

rubric.title: How the panel scores
rubric.intro: Each judge scores 1–5 on five criteria. These are the anchors for 1, 3 and 5.
rubric.weight_capstone: Capstone: Verified result and Value count double.

c1.name: Problem defined
c1.what: A gap in numbers, a date, a decision-maker and guard rails.
c1.a3: Gap in numbers and a date
c1.a5: Gap, date, decision-maker and guard rails; passes all six characteristics

c2.name: Structured analysis
c2.what: A MECE tree, priorities, hypotheses tested with data.
c2.a5: Hypothesis-driven tree, 80:20 focus, hypotheses tested with data, iterated

c3.name: Verified result
c3.what: KPI before and after from the system of record, held for 4 weeks or more.
c3.a3: KPI moved, from the system of record
c3.a5: KPI moved and held ≥ 4 weeks, with a clean before/after and no side effects

c4.name: Value and sustainability
c4.what: A VND basis that's agreed; the rule, process or tool change that keeps it.
c4.a5: Value agreed with Finance; a rule, process or tool change keeps it

c5.name: Communication
c5.what: Answer first, action titles, a one-page summary, handles questions.
c5.a5: One-page summary, action title on every slide, handles questions crisply
